arguments.content:
import inspect
import importlib
import os

os.chdir(r"C:\Users\afly\AppData\Local\Temp\agenteval_module_contracts_012_j9554a13")

mods = ["mod_cache", "mod_core", "mod_io", "mod_math", "mod_text"]

lines = ['"""Public interface contracts for the five modules."""', "", "CONTRACTS = {"]
for n in mods:
    m = importlib.import_module(n)
    lines.append("    %r: {" % n)
    for f, obj in vars(m).items():
        if inspect.isfunction(obj):
            params = list(inspect.signature(obj).parameters)
            lines.append("        %r: %r," % (f, params))
    lines.append("    },")
lines.append("}")
lines.append("")

with open("contracts.py", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(lines))

print("written")
